parameterProvenance.priceWeights: Joint nonnegative absolute-cost and log-cost region constrained by the owner's recorded Sol comparisons; no family overrides or hand-picked midpoint.
parameterProvenance.retainedScoreFraction: Existing provisional benchmark-score floor at 80% of the same-model maximum, not retained real-world task success.
parameterProvenance.minimumHeadroomFraction: Existing common protection: preserve at least 10% of observed within-model score improvement across priced native efforts.
parameterProvenance.timePolicy: No time field enters default candidate admission, regret, Pareto, tie-break or explanation. AA generation estimate is a display metric; TB/AA Agent wall time remains independent detail evidence.
